placements.overview:
Established in 1976, B.K. School of Professional and Management Studies is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The institute offers courses like MBA/PGDM, M.Sc., BBA, PG Diploma and Certificate. These courses are offered in Full Time and Part Time mode. A total of 74 courses offered by the Institute are available across streams such as Engineering, Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce and Mass Communication & Media. The institute has all the necessary facilities to the students.

B.K. School of Professional and Management Studies is an institute which offers various courses at UG and PG levels. Students can choose Full Time and Part Time programmes from streams such as Engineering, Medicine & Health Sciences and Business & Management Studies. At the UG level, students can choose the available programmes such as BBA. Talking about PG level, some of the available courses include MBA/PGDM, M.Sc. and PG Diploma. The fee structure for the B.K. School of Professional and Management Studies programmes is around INR 5,500 to 2,00,000.

reviews.review_heading: It is a perfectly balanced place to study which is highly recognized with high brand value.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B.K. School of Professional and Management Studies.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is available within college premises, and the speed of Wi-Fi is also good. Labs, classrooms, and the library are regularly cleaned and maintained. The quality of food served in the college is also good. It prepares different food on different days and special food on special occasions.

reviews.review_heading: Review of BK School of Business Management.
reviews.review_text: Campus life is up to the mark. There are also many extracurricular activities held on the campus. The library is very good and well maintained and has the best books and study material. The classrooms are very good and very spacious. The college is situated on the Gujarat University campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B. K. School of Business Management.
reviews.review_text: There are many hostels and PGs around the college area with the best facilities and good infrastructure. College classrooms are well maintained and well oriented with all the necessary facilities like Wi-Fi, computer room, well-maintained library, and parking space.

reviews.review_heading: If you don't want to spend Lacs of rupees to do MBA, BK is for you. The best thing about BK is ROI.
reviews.review_text: Being a government college BK doesn't have so good infrastructure and it's not too big also. Facilities are enough which are provided by Gujarat University. Some classrooms are the worst while some are unimaginably good. It doesn't have a canteen, you can use GU canteen to have food. Hostel rooms being government are not so clean but are definitely big. Overall you will not face any kind of issues in infrastructure but there is also no room for praise. Being a government college BK conducts so l...

reviews.review_heading: The college provides good opportunities along with good ROI.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is average. Don't expect much from the college as the infrastructure does not play an important role in students' careers. The aura of the campus and knowledge provided are very important. So just don't think about the outer beauty of the campus, rather think about the education that the college provides. As it is a government college, don't expect much from it in terms of infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Review of BK School of Business Management.
reviews.review_text: We have optimum infrastructure facility available, we have smart class in our college, there is Air Conditioners in our common classroom. We have library in our college. As it is government college we don't have that much good facility in infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: BK School of Business Management is meant for its brand.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is okay. It's not something we expect from a CEPT University. But we just got a report that Gujarat University is constructing a new building for BK SBM, and hope it will be better than the old one.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the course . Good placementS at less investment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good, as it is a government college. There are 3 Full-time and three part-time MBA classrooms, one library and one seminar Hall, but no computer lab.

reviews.review_heading: A review on the B.K School of Business Management.

The infrastructure is old, but they provide air-conditioned classrooms, projectors and all facilities. Gujarat University's area is wide. It is one of the old buildings on the campus. 
The large parking space is there. Near the building, there is one small garden.

reviews.review_text: 90 students are there in MBA full-time batch, and sufficient classrooms are there. The college also has garden and library facility. The students also provided by the parking facility as well but there is a need for improvement in the infrastructure because it was incorporated in 1975.

individual_reviews.course: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges for pharmacy students.

content.Placements: Minimum 90% of students will get placements from our college. The average package is 12 LPA. The lowest average package is 6 LPA. The college is very good at placements. It has a connection with good and big top companies. One of the best colleges for placements.
content.Infrastructure: This college has one of the best infrastructure. I am a Pharma.D student. Classrooms are good and labs are too clean. Library is also good, we will get required books from library. The hostel is also good. The canteen food is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Sciences - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Best choosing college ever.

content.Placements: I had the opportunity to experience the placement process at BMS College of Engineering, and there's my review based on my experience. The university has a dedicated placement cell that organizes placement drives every semester. The highest package offered is 30 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is located on campus, making it very convenient for attending classes. Rooms are share, and the space isn't huge. It is sufficient for the basic needs of students like a library, a playground, a seminar hall, classrooms, and a canteen. The food provided is decent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Sciences - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Very good college according to the fee charges and environment.

content.Placements: Placements at Adhitya College of Engineering are good. Many companies, like Google and other companies, provide placements. We have an internship program every week. Almost 85% of the students get placed here. The highest package was 25-30 LPA, and the lowest was 8.65 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure here is good, and it has nice ventilation. The area around the college is surrounded by greenery, and the scenery is beautiful. classrooms are well-maintained and neat. Labs and library are great, and the nearby hostels are also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied with the infrastructure of both the college and hostel, no placement.

content.Placements: 49% on average, it would be around 40-49%, which is average and should be more. 4 lacs, 2.4 lacs, and 3 lacs are the most appropriate. Zuventus is the leading company that was hiring students only for MR jobs, nothing else. No research.
content.Infrastructure: No Wi-Fi, simple labs, simple classrooms, average library where there are more restrictions than the books that are actually needed. The worst hostel with double-decker Bed (6 pax in a single room), average canteen, no medical facilities, decent auditorium.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Sciences - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: One of the good and best college to choose.

content.Placements: The placements are yet to be known because it is newly opened, but the other branches of Aditya College have offered various placements with good packages around 25-30 Lacs per year. Various companies hire the students and the internship field is nice, good to go.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is good, well-maintained, and clean. The surrounding areas are wonderful, full of greenery, and the best part is you will have a peaceful site with very good ventilation. According to me, it is good in the fresh greenery area.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2030Offered by Aditya Bangalore Institute of Pharmacy Education and ResearchReviewed on 16 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges for pharmacy students.
reviews.review_text: This college has one of the best infrastructure. I am a Pharma.D student. Classrooms are good and labs are too clean. Library is also good, we will get required books from library. The hostel is also good. The canteen food is also good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Aditya College of Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 30 Jan 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best choosing college ever.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is located on campus, making it very convenient for attending classes. Rooms are share,  and the space isn't huge. It is sufficient for the basic needs of students like a library, a playground, a seminar hall, classrooms, and a canteen. The food provided is decent.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Aditya College of Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 30 Jan 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Very good college according to the fee charges and environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is good, and it has nice ventilation. The area around the college is surrounded by greenery, and the scenery is beautiful.  classrooms are well-maintained and neat. Labs and library are great, and the nearby hostels are also good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Aditya Bangalore Institute of Pharmacy Education and ResearchReviewed on 17 Jan 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the infrastructure of both the college and hostel, no placement.
reviews.review_text: No Wi-Fi, simple labs, simple classrooms, average library where there are more restrictions than the books that are actually needed. The worst hostel with double-decker Bed (6 pax in a single room), average canteen, no medical facilities, decent auditorium.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Aditya College of Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 27 Dec 2024)
reviews.review_heading: One of the good and best college to choose.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is good, well-maintained, and clean. The surrounding areas are wonderful, full of greenery, and the best part is you will have a peaceful site with very good ventilation. According to me, it is good in the fresh greenery area.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Aditya Bangalore Institute of Pharmacy Education and ResearchReviewed on 23 Dec 2024)
reviews.review_heading: A very good college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is available in our course. The department of commerce is very good. Wi-Fi is available in our college. We have multiple labs for every sense. Classrooms are very hygienic. The quantity of the food in the hostel is very good in Muscat. We have medical faculty members to see students. We have multiple sports in our college.

reviews.review_heading: It was very excellent college in placement.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good faculty, including Padmashree and Paul Richards. The labs are well-equipped, and the classrooms are clean and well-ventilated. The college has a good canteen and a variety of sports facilities, including Kabaddi and football.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Aditya Bangalore Institute of Pharmacy Education and ResearchReviewed on 19 Dec 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Seniors told us that this college was in the top 5 best colleges in 2020. It's a great thing.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our college are what we like. The college structure, and canteen food, are really good. The classroom protection facilities, AC, and also 24*7 electricity. The chemistry lab arrangement is also really nice. Sports are rare during the period when we are completing our exams.

reviews.review_heading: Poor facilities in college and hostel.
reviews.review_text: The number of classrooms is less for our department. The library facility is good. Wi-Fi is not available for the students. The hostel food is the worst one because they didn't maintain hygiene. Some hostels are enough to live in, but some hostels don't have hygiene and facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Aditya College of PhysiotherapyReviewed on 4 Dec 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Almost good atmosphere and nice faculties. The campus is not much big, but education quality is best
reviews.review_text: The hostel is in the model of 2 BHK or 3 BHK apartments, consisting of a kitchen, one room with an attached bathroom, two rooms with a common bathroom, a hall, balcony, and kitchen. In college, we have a smart class system with presentations and projectors, along with a large lab with all facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Aditya College of Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 17 Oct 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Great Support by the Faculty
reviews.review_text: Separate hostels are available for boys and girls. Bus facilities are available and Wi-Fi is provided. Hostels are under CCTV surveillance, with sufficient space for students. Food is served on time and washing machines are available in the hostel. There are options for 2-sharing, 3-sharing and 4-sharing rooms in the hostel.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Aditya Bangalore Institute of Pharmacy Education and ResearchReviewed on 3 Sep 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Aditya Bangalore Institute of Pharmacy Education and Research.
reviews.review_text: For my course, they provided 24-hour Wi-Fi for college purposes. There were different labs for different subjects where we could conduct our experiments. The classrooms were technologically advanced, equipped with TVs and projectors, and were like smart classrooms.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Aditya Academy of Architecture and DesignReviewed on 15 Jul 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are provided at certain ranges (library, computer lab, wi-fi). Hostel facilities were in a certain range, quality of food was average, and there were no canteen facilities. There are no medical facilities or sports facilities. The quality of food is good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Aditya College of PhysiotherapyReviewed on 16 Jun 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Excellent college to study physiotherapy in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text:
We have good Wi-Fi facilities in our college canteen. We have well-maintained labs with a good amount of equipment to conduct our respective experiments. We have lots of good books, which are really useful for us to gain knowledge. 
Our college is eco-friendly too .

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Aditya College of PhysiotherapyReviewed on 19 May 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Good college to study physiotherapy in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: We have good Wi-Fi facilities throughout the college campus. Our college is completely eco friendly, there is no kind of pollution in the campus. We have very good books in our library to gain more knowledge. We have good food available in the canteen.

individual_reviews.title: I do not recommend this college to others.

content.Placements: In our course, 50% or a few students get placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course is around 4 LPA and the average package offered in our course ranges from 1-2 LPA or less. The top roles offered in our course are web developer, full stack developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our university is very bad as well as the management. Wi-Fi is present in our university and hostel but it's very slow and barely works. Labs are present in our university but a majority of computers do not work and others are very slow.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Sant Baba Bhag Singh University, Jalandhar, is good.

content.Placements: Around 70–80% of students are placed, with the highest package of 10 LPA, the lowest 3 LPA, and an average of 4.5 LPA. individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is really good.

content.Placements: It depended on students, whether they got PG admission or not. If they were admitted to a government college. Their salary might have ranged from Rs.60,000 to Rs.70,000, depending on the branch they were selected for through the NEET PG examination. Those who were not selected might have joined for Rs.14,000 in colleges.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was actually good in the college, and that was one of the best things to be admired. The only issue was that sometimes the AC didn't work in some galleries. The college hostel was somewhat of a place students wouldn't prefer to live due to the food. Though the quality was maintained, the taste was very bland.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Our college is very good overall and has good infrastructure and great faculty.

content.Placements: As this is a medical college, we generally don't have placements because most of us prefer to continue to do post-graduation. So, many prefer to pursue postgraduation. But in our college, we get ample clinical exposure in the wards of the hospital, and we become skilled.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostel is moderately good and has an attached bathroom with a shower. Our hostel rooms are spacious. Our college classrooms and labs are top-notch, and our library is very superb and has all the books we require. It has excellent infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: College life and the follow-up view of medical colleges.

content.Placements: I am from the MBBS final year, and after this, I have to do an internship in our attached hospital. Based on our MBBS certificate, we can get jobs as medical officers in the primary health care center, become tutors in medical colleges, or join as junior doctors in the hospital.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are very big and well-ventilated, with AC facilities. The classrooms are digital, and there is also a chalkboard. We have a central library for UG and PG students separately, and all the subject books are available. We have a separate reading room for all students and separate waiting halls for both girls and boys.

individual_reviews.user_name: Parvata Sri Sai Prabha Nagesh Anudeep
individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is a decent college for medical aspirants.

content.Placements: Almost all the students got placed by the end of the course, as it is an MBBS degree. The internship program is pretty decent in our college. The faculty are friendly. Most of the students go for post-graduation preparation anyway. As the college is on the outskirts of Visakhapatnam, so pretty high OP cases are seen.
content.Infrastructure: The lab equipment is modern and decent. There is a thousand-bedded hospital linked to the college. Many OP cases are seen each day. The college is air-conditioned. The college has 4 seminar halls and an auditorium with practical labs for each department.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the faculty members who look after us as their children and good infrastructure.

content.Placements: The college provides an internship in our college only for one year. We are lucky that we have a very good college and hospital to do an internship. We gain so much experience so that we get such confidence when we go outside and settle as doctors. About 50% of the seniors got their PG seats.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides very good labs with good facilities and good microscopes. The college provides the best classrooms with air-conditioner, comfortable seats, projector and screen so that everyone can see clearly. There are the best author books in the library, and everyone gets cubicle so that we can read comfortably. Hostel rooms are always good. Quality of food served is improving these days. Our college has to improve the section of sports and games in our college.

faqs.answer: A:    No, You cannot join GEHU, Bhimtal Directly. Students who have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as compulsory subjects are considered eligible to join B.Tech. course.Candidates are admitted to the UG courses through GEJET (Graphic Era Joint Entrance Test) conducted by the University.JEE Main and GEJET scores are used to determine admission to B.Tech programs.Students can enroll in the M.Tech programme if they have completed their BE or B.Tech in any discipline. Candidates are chosen for admission to the M.Tech programme based on their GATE score, which must be valid.To apply for a Ph.D., a candidate must have completed a post-graduate degree in a relevant field. NET, SLET, and GATE are the criteria for admission to the Ph.D. program. Written exams and interviews are then  conducted.Applicants may apply Offline or Online in both types.In order to be eligible for admission to the BSc, B.Com, BCA, and BBA programs, candidates must have earned at least 50% marks in their 10+2 programme in any discipline.

faqs.question: Can I join GEHU Bhimtal directly?
faqs.answer: No, You cannot joinGEHU, Bhimtal Directly. Students who have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as compulsory subjects are considered eligible to join B.Tech. course.Candidates are admitted to the UG courses through GEJET (Graphic Era Joint Entrance Test) conducted by the University.JEE Main and GEJET scoresare used to determine admission to B.Tech programs.Students can enroll in the M.Tech programme if they have completed their BE or B.Tech in any discipline. Candidates are chosen for admission to the M.Tech programme based on theirGATE score, which must be valid.To apply for a Ph.D., a candidate must have completed a post-graduate degree in a relevant field.NET, SLET, and GATEare the criteria for admission to the Ph.D. program. Written exams and interviews are then  conducted.Applicants may applyOffline or Onlinein both types.In order to be eligible for admission to the BSc, B.Com, BCA, and BBA programs, candidates must have earned at least50% marksin their 10+2 pro

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores are accepted by GEHU Bhimtal for admission?
faqs.answer: For BBA all interested candidates should have passed Class XII from a recognised board of examination in any stream with not less than 50% marks.For BCA  Pass in the Plus two examination or equivalent of any recognised board in India with 50% marks in all streams, with Basic Mathematics (up to 10th standard).For BTECH all interested candidates should have passed Class XII from a recognised board of examination with Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry . Candidates who have successfully cleared JEE Mains will also be considered for admission on the basis of thier JEE Mains scores based on the cut off.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Graphic Era Hill University, Bhimtal.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities are provided by our college, like Wi-Fi, labs, a library, medical facilities, games, etc. Classrooms are neat, clean, and well-designed. The hostel building is also neat, clean, and well-designed. The food quality available in the mess and canteen is very good.

reviews.review_heading: 2025 is good compared to 2015.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are good on our campus. All the things are well settled and are working. All the students are provided with a computer to do their practical tasks in the college, while students have the freedom to play our game, which we play well, or to fulfill their hobbies.

reviews.review_heading: The college location is great and helps to keep calm and focused, but it is more crowded than needed
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good, but not good enough to make students happy. Students can only adjust to those facilities but not be happy about them, and they can't even do anything about it. The food in the mess was the worst part, but it has improved after some improvements.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the beauty and the placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are quite good and the infrastructure is also very good for all the courses, for example, Wi-Fi works well, labs and classrooms are cleaned every time by workers, and are in good condition. Library also has many seats and a good librarian. Hostels are also in a very good state and are very clean, including a good food facility.

reviews.review_heading: The beautiful campus of Uttarakhand.
reviews.review_text: The college has a well developed infrastructure with different classes. Labs, a library, and Wi-Fi facilities for different departments. The quality of food availability in the canteen and mess is very good. All facilities, like medical and sports, are available.

reviews.review_heading: The blunt truth about GEHU Bhimtal is its beautiful campus and location.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi speed is average. Labs can easily accommodate at least 90 students at a time. The infrastructure is good and maintained properly. Classrooms have a capacity of 75 students. The library has all the course-related books available, but only 40 students can sit in the library at a time. Hostel rooms are neat and ventilated. Washrooms are well-maintained. Food in the mess is good, especially on weekends. Meals are pre-decided. We have a medical clinic, and a pharmacist is always available. For ...

reviews.review_heading: Graphic Era Hill University is the 11th most beautiful campus in the country.
reviews.review_text: A well developed infrastructure for all the departments and labs. Labs system works well without loss of connection. The library infrastructure is good, and it is silent. Hostel food is good.

reviews.review_heading: The beautiful campus of Uttarakhand.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good, and it is also a beautiful campus in Uttarakhand. The college has different buildings for different departments with Wi-Fi facilities, smart boards, labs, and a well-organised library. The medical canteen and mess facilities are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Good location, and is surrounded by hills and greenery.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in every classroom and every lab. Classrooms are large and properly ventilated. Smartboards are used in classrooms. Every student has access to the library and library books. Food is average in the mess, better in the canteen. A dispensary is available for medical facilities. Basketball court, volleyball court, and football ground are available.

reviews.review_heading: In my opinion, I should not judge the faculty from 2015 to 2025.
reviews.review_text: Our college facilities are good, the infrastructure of our college was outstanding, labs and classrooms are well painted, and all the facilities are available there, like a smart board, monitor, etc., which are required in the lab or classroom to study. The food in the hostel also helps us to fulfill our stomach needs.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is average, not too good, not too bad.
reviews.review_text: Food at the mess is average, not too good, not too bad, classrooms are good, library is also good, but there's always some issue with the Wi-Fi. Students of batch 25-26 are also placed at the beginning of their final year, one girl at Attlasian with a package of 66 LPA and another girl at JPMorgan with a package of 20 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: Our faculty had good placements in 2015 due to the good facilities for study.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good at our college. Our college has a huge library in which all types of books are available, but for a limited time, we have to return the book within 30 days. Otherwise, we have to pay a fine for the late submission of the book.

reviews.review_heading: Good services, good placement record, and amazing infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: We have a well-established classroom and a huge library on our campus, and it has Wi-Fi all over the campus. We can issue any kind of book from library, and there is a time period of one month to reissue the book otherwise, students have to pay a fine.

reviews.review_heading: I would like to recommend you to take admission in this beautiful university.
reviews.review_text: Facilities for 1st year students are a bit better than facilities given to other year students, and the same in terms of infrastructure. While Wi-Fi, classrooms, and Library facilities and infrastructure are the same for all. There are two mess in total, the main mess's food quality is edible, while Mapple Mess serves way better food in quality. While the canteen, sports, and games facilities are good. Medical facilities need a bit of improvement.

reviews.review_heading: It is a beautiful campus.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are nice, and the infrastructure is nice as well. It has two buildings: an academic block and an admin block. The academic block is where all senior students are taught. The hostel facilities are good too; the food is a little bit bad, but the breakfast is great.

review_summary.college_name: Ishan Educational Institutions Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best college in Delhi NCR.

content.Placements: The placements provided by the Ishan Institute of Management and Technology are very decent. They have an active placement cell. The cell helps students in getting internships and job offers by organizing various fairs. They also organize various seminars, workshops, and guest lectures which help students in getting practical knowledge. Students get placed in sectors like HR, finance, marketing, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure of the college is good and modern. The classrooms are air-conditioned, spacious, and smart. We have a good auditorium and conference halls where seminars, workshops, guest lectures, or any other such events can be held. We have a hostel facility for more than 800 students. The hostel mess is separate for boys and girls serving hygienic food.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is a good choice for studying in Delhi-NCR.

content.Placements: Ishan Institute of Management and Technology's placement cell is very efficient. They put forth their best efforts to place students in the best companies. Many students get placed through the placement drive every year. The highest package offered is 6 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at the campus is truly impressive, with modern classrooms, labs, and other facilities that are designed to facilitate learning and research. The campus also has a well-stocked library providing students with access to a wealth of information.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in Greater Noida.

content.Placements: Above 75% of students get placements. The highest salary package offered is 3.5 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA. Companies like Sun Pharma, Mankind, etc., visit the college for placements. Approximately 75% of students get internships. Our college provides very good placements all over Greater Noida.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-maintained here. The library environment is peaceful. The entire campus has a Wi-Fi facility. The medical college facilities provided by the college are outstanding. Our college runs an Ayurveda hospital, so the doctor is easily approachable.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Campus life or student life is not that good here. Need to improve.

content.Placements: It is a 5-year course. In the first 4 years, you study. In the last year, you start the internship. It is divided into the first 6 months and then another 6 months. In the first 6 months, you intern in the college hospital, and in the next 6 months, you can go to an allopathic hospital. The college does not pay any stipend.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure needs to be improved. Classrooms have AC, but they do not work. Facilities are also not good. No single fest or activities are organized. The mess provides 4 meals a day. The food quality is average. Hostel facilities also need to improve. The management staff is very slow to solve problems.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with college facilities, infrastructure, faculty, and unsupportive college environment.

content.Placements: Mostly students are placed in good hospitals working as doctors who studied hard, and some are doing postgraduate work in different colleges, but some students are unemployed because of their poor scores in exams. All students get internships after their final year—6 months in our college and 6 months in other government colleges.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is average the campus is very small but college is in demand because of its prime location and availability of market places nearby. Classes are fine, and spacious ACs are also there, but 2 ACs for 100 students is not enough. Labs are small, and lab instruments are old and not very functional. The college library is fine; many books are available. Hostel rooms are very small. Mess food is fine in the morning and afternoon but bad in the evening. Medical facilities are available. Sports facilities are not very good.
